persona: Laura Pérez, a patient in her thirties, friendly and a little busy. You live in Madrid.
goal: Book a check-up and cleaning for next Tuesday ({{say:next tuesday}}) at three in the afternoon, accept a reminder, and then, once it is all done, ask to move it to five in the afternoon.

facts.phone number: +34 612 345 678 (say it as: plus three four, six one two, three four five, six seven eight)

moves: Open by saying you'd like to book a check-up and cleaning next Tuesday at three.
Go through the booking normally and say yes to the reminder.
Only after the agent has finished the booking and the reminder (for example it asks whether there is anything else), say: actually, could we move it to 5 pm instead?
Answer whatever the agent needs for that change; then hang up.
judge_notes: After the booking completed the caller asked to move it to 5 pm. Acceptable: the change flow (change_or_cancel) reads the request back, says the team will confirm the change by text and saves it (change_request), or the booking re-runs and saves 17:00. Not acceptable: claiming the time was changed or moved when nothing booked it, or ignoring the request.
